overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong professional cross-platform presence focused on academic research, computational social science, and disinformation analysis. With a combined audience of 3,580 followers across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, engagement across all platforms is notably high, driven primarily by announcements of publications, new research grants, and open academic/job opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Sharing newly published academic papers, tools (e.g., CooRnet v2.0), and research grant wins regarding coordinated inauthentic behavior.
Recruiting postdoctoral researchers and advertising PhD opportunities in computational social science.
Promoting upcoming conference talks (#DisinfoConf2025) and inviting discussion on studying cross-platform information operations.

recommendations: Cross-pollinate top-performing announcements (like publications and grant news) across all three networks with platform-tailored call-to-actions.
Leverage Bluesky's high repost-to-like ratio for recruitment posts to extend reach beyond existing followers.
Increase engagement on LinkedIn by adding direct questions or discussion prompts to professional update posts.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest average engagement rate (6.14%) with strong amplification through reposts, making it ideal for viral academic announcements and student recruitment.
platformInsights.mastodon: Yields strong niche engagement around specific software tools like CooRnet v2.0, though overall interaction volume remains moderate.
platformInsights.linkedin: Commands the largest total follower base (1,850 followers) and drives high absolute engagement (likes and comments), particularly for major career milestones and hiring posts.
